rows.name: UKHSA respiratory viruses dashboard
rows.semantic_limit: National and surveillance-system metrics support population-level health context only; they do not identify infection or risk at an exact parcel, household or individual.
rows.evidence_basis: Official UKHSA dashboard covers COVID-19, influenza, RSV and other respiratory viruses and states its update date and surveillance scope.

rows.name: UKHSA heat-health alerts dashboard
rows.semantic_limit: Regional alert colour, likelihood and impact are area-level emergency-planning signals; they must not be converted into an exact building or parcel heat-risk score.
rows.evidence_basis: Official UKHSA dashboard provides regional heat-health alert states and the alert period for 29 to 30 July 2026.

rows.name: Weather-Health Alert system user guide
rows.semantic_limit: The user guide defines joint risk assessment and alert-response methodology; it is not an observation of conditions at a location and cannot release a parcel score.
rows.evidence_basis: Official guidance describes UKHSA and Met Office monitoring, evidence-based joint assessment, alert seasons and public-health response.

rows.name: Met Office National Severe Weather Warning Service guide
rows.semantic_limit: Warnings describe forecast impact and likelihood over warning areas up to seven days ahead; an exact parcel impact requires spatial containment, timing and warning-version verification.
rows.evidence_basis: Official Met Office guide covers yellow, amber and red warnings for rain, thunderstorms, wind, snow, lightning, ice, extreme heat and fog.

rows.name: UK-AIR latest measurement summary
rows.publisher: Department for Environment, Food and Rural Affairs
rows.semantic_limit: Regional maximum indices and monitoring-site measurements are provisional area or station observations; they do not establish exact on-parcel exposure without station-distance and representativeness controls.
rows.evidence_basis: Official UK-AIR service publishes latest Environment Agency measurements, regional Daily Air Quality Index summaries and monitoring-site drill-downs.
